fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $1,250. Reduced fee of $625.00 applies to: (1) franchisees reinstated within 12 months of resignation (returning franchise fee), and (2) Jazzercise employees of at least 90 days who become franchisees owning classes. A gift program allows existing franchisees to gift a franchise to a new franchisee, in which case no initial fee is required. Business owner franchisees cannot be reinstated. Fee is non-refundable except if franchisee decides not to attend training, fails the audition, or fails to complete training — in which case the fee is refunded less $500.00. Jazzercise may offer additional promotions or discounts.
raw_excerpt: Except as described below, all franchisees, including franchisees in foreign countries, pay an initial franchise fee of $1,250. If you resign but are reinstated within 12 months, you pay a returning franchise fee of $625.00. Business owner franchisees do not have the option of reinstatement. If you have been an employee of Jazzercise for at least 90 days and you become a franchisee who owns classes, your initial franchise fee is $625.00.
